idee_recherchee.texte: The Big Bang was not an explosion in space but the rapid expansion of space itself from an extremely hot and dense state about 13.8 billion years ago, and the question of what came before it remains unanswered.

resume: The narrator asks how big the Big Bang explosion was and admits nobody knows how it began or what existed beforehand. A fraction of a second after it, the universe began expanding dramatically, and since its size today is unknown it is impossible to say, though it was probably the biggest explosion. He concludes that humans have explored only a small fraction of the universe and understand less than what remains unknown.
